Package com.vector.cfg.core.project

DaVinci Configurator Project interface and basic type defintions like Project states and phases.

See: Description

  • Enum Summary 
    Enum Description
    EConfigurationPhase
    This enumeration represents the project's configuration phase.
    EEnvironmentProjectType
    The EEnvironmentProjectType represents the possible project types.
    EEnvironmentProjectTypeDomain
    The EEnvironmentProjectTypeDomain represents the possible project type domains.
    EEnvironmentTargetType
    The EEnvironmentTargetType represents the possible target types and provides comfort functions to check whether target type supports real target ( EEnvironmentTargetType.isRealAvailable()) and/or virtual target ( EEnvironmentTargetType.isVttAvailable()).
